NSH::mocksf
       Set option to mock SF functionality for NSH.

SYNOPSIS
       NSH::mocksf

DESCRIPTION
       Set option to mock SF functionality for NSH.

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	# Set the mocksf option for NSH.
	when FLOW_INIT {
	    NSH::mocksf
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-13.1.0
		       --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
